title: NeonVoter
description: A Folia-compatible Votifier receiver and reward manager that handles vote server protocols, rewards, and offline queues in one optimized plugin.
body:
# **🗳️ NeonVoter**
NeonVoter is a lightweight, high-performance, and fully Folia-compatible voting plugin for modern Minecraft servers.

It combines a built-in Votifier v1 & v2 receiver with a powerful reward system, eliminating the need for a separate Votifier plugin while keeping setup simple and performance focused.

✨ Features
⚡ Built for Folia with thread-safe scheduling.
🔌 Built-in Votifier v1 & v2 receiver.
🔐 Automatic RSA key generation.
🎁 Flexible reward system with commands, titles, sounds, broadcasts, and messages.
📅 Vote milestones and vote streak rewards.
💾 Offline vote queue with automatic reward delivery.
📂 JSON and MySQL storage support.
🚀 Lightweight and optimized for modern servers.
🚀 Why NeonVoter?

NeonVoter combines everything you need into a single plugin:

✔ Built-in vote receiver
✔ Reward management
✔ Offline vote support
✔ Vote streak tracking
✔ Milestone rewards

No additional Votifier plugin required.

# ⚙️ Example Configuration

```
rewards:
  - name: Default Vote Reward
    services: []
    conditions: []
    actions:
      - COMMAND:give {player} diamond 1
      - MESSAGE:&aThanks for voting!
      - SOUND:ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP
      - TITLE:&6Thank You!|&aRewards Delivered!
```

# 📦 Supported Storage
```
 - JSON
 - MySQL
 ```
# 🎮 Supported Platforms
```
 - Folia
 - Paper
```
Java 21+

# ❤️ Developed by Other Side

Other Side is focused on building modern, high-performance Minecraft plugins and tools for the Paper ecosystem, with an emphasis on clean code, reliability, and ease of use.

If you have feedback, feature requests, or would like to contribute, feel free to get involved.
